decisions_recent.decision: Implemented proxy request-class policy and UI-read circuit breaker: ui_read requests now use 2s timeout with no internal retries and transient-based fast-fail after consecutive failures; background sync uses dedicated retry policy. Also reduced workbench enrichment churn by removing 30s suggestion polling/retries and making sync trigger manual-first (no automatic stale-triggered sync-on-read).
decisions_recent.rationale: This directly addresses minute-long stalls during outages by bounding read latency, preventing repeated retry storms, and eliminating automatic read-path sync/proxy pressure. Background sync remains retry-capable through the snapshot transport path.

decisions_recent.decision: Implemented first Phase 0.5 performance slice: workbench media now serves medium-sized thumbnails with srcset/sizes metadata, MediaSelection keeps rows visible during background refetch, and identity background churn was reduced (no next-page identity prefetch, no retry loop, polling stops after errors, 2s client timeout for media-identities call).
decisions_recent.rationale: Addresses the observed unusable behavior by reducing image payload weight and preventing refetch/loading churn from blocking perceived navigation responsiveness while recognition service is offline.

decisions_recent.decision: Corrected Phase 0.5 framing: thumbnail throughput and page navigation responsiveness are in-scope and currently degraded; they are not separate/unrelated to offline usability. Handoff now prioritizes payload/render-path fixes together with enrichment decoupling.
decisions_recent.rationale: User-observed behavior (page 2 >60s under outage, thumbnails taking minutes, page-back delays) indicates user-facing bottlenecks across both enrichment wait paths and media/thumbnail delivery path. To avoid recurrence, the plan now couples decoupling work with explicit UX SLOs and promotes sized-thumbnail delivery to P1.

decisions_recent.decision: Evaluated blocker #2 and decision #19: media navigation (GET /workbench/media) and thumbnails are already local-only and never proxy. The actual stall source is enrichment auto-polling (suggestions every 30s, sync trigger on stale, media-identities proxy fallback) where each failed call burns ~93.5s (30s timeout x 3 retries + backoff). Reprioritized: lazy-load enrichment (#10) elevated to P1 (highest impact/lowest effort), sized thumbnails (#11) split out as unrelated perf task, stale-while-revalidate (#9) retargeted to enrichment queries not media rows, and new action added for frontend AbortSignal.timeout() on recognition API calls.
decisions_recent.rationale: Code trace confirmed: fetchWorkbenchMedia() hits local WP_Query only (class-api.php). Thumbnails are WP media URLs. The proxy base class (class-abstract-recognition-proxy-controller.php) uses 30s GET timeout, 3 retries with exponential backoff, no circuit breaker. Frontend http.ts accepts AbortSignal but no caller uses AbortSignal.timeout(). Suggestions/merge-suggestions poll at 30s intervals via always-proxy endpoints. Blocking #2 framing of 'page navigation and thumbnails' is misleading — corrected to 'enrichment auto-polling'.

decisions_recent.decision: Workbench media navigation must be hard-decoupled from recognition-service availability: local media browse path only, recognition enrichment best-effort, and proxy failures fast-fail via circuit breaker.
decisions_recent.rationale: Current request path can stall for 60-180s when recognition is offline because proxy GETs use long timeout/retries and frontend retries stack on top. Media navigation should remain responsive regardless of service health.
